pages.title: Arctotherium
pages.text: $(o)Arctotherium$() ($(o)Arctotherium angustidens$()) is an extinct short-faced bear that lived on the pampas of South America during the Pleistocene, roughly one million years ago.$(br2)Its ancestors reached South America from the north during the Great American Interchange.$(br2)It is among the largest bears ever known, with the biggest individuals estimated to have weighed well over a tonne.
